plot: On game morning the red ball keeps vanishing and reappearing; Bolt tests Sunny the ice cream truck, Pip (hiding Turbo's banana) and Bertha (giant honk), then a boing sound and round bounce marks lead to Grumpy, who wanted to play but didn't know how to ask; he asks 'Can I play?' and joins, then Bolt's hat goes missing.

script.title: Can You Catch the Ball Bandit? ⚽🔍 Cartoon Cars for Kids
script.description: On game morning the red ball keeps vanishing and coming back. Inspector Bolt listens for the boing.

beats.say: Boing! Boing! It was game morning in Wheelburg, and everybody zoomed in to play Bounce Ball!
Good morning, everybody! Ice cream for the winners, and ice cream for the losers!
Then I want four. One for each wheel!
I'm going to bounce the ball higher than a bus!
Higher than me? Ha! Good luck, little one!
Only one truck stayed back in the shade. Grumpy.
Games are loud. And bouncy. I'll just watch from here.
The shiny red ball sat on the podium, ready for the very first game.
Ready, everyone? On your marks... get set...
Where did it go? It was right there a second ago!
Maybe it bounced all the way to the moon!
Balls don't bounce to the moon. Believe me, I've tried.
Then, poof! The ball was back on the podium, just like before.
Phew! It's back! Okay, let's play!
Okay. Now this is getting really weird.
Weird. Very weird. I'm going to look... over there.
Honk honk! A blue car with a brown hat rolled into the square.
Inspector Bolt. I hear we have a ball that comes and goes.
A ball cannot hide all by itself. Somebody is helping it.
A ball bandit! In our town!
Everyone, to the Truth Press. Sunny, you brought the ice cream, so you go first.
Me? I've never been squeezed before! Is it cold, like ice cream?
Sunny, did you take the red ball?
No! My freezer is full of ice cream. There's no room for a ball!
The press squeezed the ice cream truck, very gently.
Oof! Now I'm a flat ice cream truck! A pancake truck!
Eyes small. Sunny is honest. And a little bit flatter.
Next. Little Pip.
Me? I didn't take the ball. I promise, promise, promise.
Pip, your eyes just got very big. Is something hiding in your trunk?
Squeeze! And out popped... a banana!
My banana! Pip, you had my banana?!
Grumpy kept looking at it, so I kept it safe for you! You're welcome!
I was only going to look at it. Mostly.
Pip! You're my hero! My tiny snack hero!
A banana is a snack, not a ball. Pip, you may go.
Big Bertha. Your turn.
Here I come! I didn't take it. I was busy warming up my honk!
Bertha, did you take the red ball?
No! I wanted to play more than anybody!
The Truth Press squeezed, and Bertha let out the loudest honk in Wheelburg.
My ears! I mean... my mirrors!
Eyes small. Very honest. Very loud.
Three honest cars. But the red ball was still missing.
Let's all be quiet for a moment. And listen.
Everyone held very still. Then they heard it. Boing. Boing. Boing.
That sound is coming from the shade. Right behind the tow truck.
And on the ground were little round marks, bouncing all the way to Grumpy.
Grumpy? Is the boing... you?
No. I'm a truck. Trucks don't boing.
Boing! The red ball jumped right out of Grumpy's tow hook!
Grumpy! But you said games are too loud and too bouncy!
Why did you keep taking the ball and bringing it back?
I wanted to try bouncing it. Just once. In the shade, where nobody could see.
Every time I tried, I got nervous and put it back. Then I tried again.
But why didn't you just play with us?
Nobody asked me. And I didn't know how to ask.
I always say I hate games. I thought you would all laugh at me.
The square went quiet. Then Inspector Bolt drove over to Grumpy.
Grumpy. There are three little words that open every game in town.
Can I play? Say them, and see what happens.
Um. Can... can I play?
YES!
Yes, yes, YES! You can be on my team!
And the very first ice cream is yours!
And next time, ask before you borrow the ball. Then nobody has to worry.
Deal. Sorry, everybody.
And so the big game began, with everyone playing together.
Grumpy, catch!
I caught it! I caught it! ...I mean. That was okay.
Look, everyone! Grumpy is smiling!
No, I'm not. ...Only a little.
Case closed. Want to play? Just ask. Those are the best words in Wheelburg.
But in all that bouncing, nobody noticed one very important thing.
My hat! Where is my detective hat?
Look closely. Can you spot who has Inspector Bolt's hat?

It's game morning in Wheelburg, but the red ball keeps vanishing… and coming back… and vanishing again! Inspector Bolt puts Sunny the ice cream truck, little Pip and Big Bertha on the Truth Press, then listens for a tiny boing. Want to play? Just ask! Inspector Bolt #4
